description: Measure distance, wall thickness, draft, rays/ray grids, point geometry, planar sections, or edge continuity. Use the artifact reference and entity IDs from the same find_entities result. Lengths are in the declared unit, which is labelled on every result. Ray grids report their grid size and can be refined with max_rays up to 20000. Fetch the cad://help resource for the required fields of each kind. Returns geometric measurements only, not engineering acceptance or design recommendations.

artifact.description: Revision-bound STEP reference from inspect: { uri, revision, format, units }. Rejected if the file changed since inspect.

revision.description: sha256 revision returned by inspect. Rejected if the file changed since then, which is what keeps IDs and measurements bound to one revision.

units.description: Spatial unit of the source file; echoed from inspect.

uri.description: Same STEP file the revision came from, as a file: URI or absolute path.

bidirectional.description: ray and ray_grid: also shoot from the origin in the opposite direction.

checks.description: point_analysis: one or more of contains_body, classify_face, closest_face_point, surface_curvature, edge_projection.

direction.description: ray and ray_grid: ray direction as an explicit [x, y, z] vector. Mutually exclusive with direction_mode.

direction_mode.description: ray and ray_grid: "axis" shoots along the entity axis, "normal" along the entity normal (faces only). Mutually exclusive with direction.

entity_ids.description: Every kind except distance: the entities to measure. Faces for thickness, draft, ray and ray_grid; edges for continuity; faces or bodies for section and point_analysis. Up to 100 IDs.

items.description: Entity ID. Whole part: "face:N", "edge:N", "vertex:N", or "body:N". Assembly occurrence: "component:<name>#<instance>/face:N".

kind.description: Measurement to perform. Each kind takes a different argument set; see the field notes here and the per-kind requirements in cad://help.

max_distance.description: ray, ray_grid and thickness: ignore hits beyond this distance in the STEP artifact’s declared length units.

max_rays.description: ray_grid and thickness: maximum ray casts, 1 to 20000. Default 4000. Raising it allows a finer grid at proportionally higher cost.

origin.description: ray and ray_grid: explicit ray origin [x, y, z]. Mutually exclusive with origin_mode.

origin_mode.description: ray and ray_grid: place the origin at the entity extent instead of passing origin: extent_min, extent_center (default), or extent_max.

plane_origin.description: section: a point on the cutting plane.

points.description: point_analysis: points to test, in model coordinates (mm), up to 100.

pull_direction.description: draft only: mould pull direction as an explicit [x, y, z] vector. Mutually exclusive with pull_direction_mode.

pull_direction_mode.description: draft only: "axis" or "normal" shortcut for the pull direction (faces only). Mutually exclusive with pull_direction.

sources.description: distance only: entities to measure from (face:N, edge:N, body:N, or a component-scoped form).

items.description: Entity ID. Whole part: "face:N", "edge:N", "vertex:N", or "body:N". Assembly occurrence: "component:<name>#<instance>/face:N".

spacing.description: ray_grid: grid pitch in the STEP artifact’s declared length units, at most 1000.

summary.description: distance only: "all" returns every pair, "minimum" (default) returns the closest pair only.

targets.description: distance only: entities to measure to.

items.description: Entity ID. Whole part: "face:N", "edge:N", "vertex:N", or "body:N". Assembly occurrence: "component:<name>#<instance>/face:N".

tolerance.description: continuity and point checks: geometric tolerance in millimetres.

name: measure
title: Measure Geometry
